newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee slipped 0.02 to 41.15 at Thursday's close against the dollar on slightly higher demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.

"The dollar firmed against most Asian currencies and this trend was reflected here as well," a dealer said. "Towards the end, dollar demand rose slightly. But the rupee, range-bounded for the past few days, will remain stable at these levels."
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.65 percent.
